title: The Amber-Braided Dreamer's Project
summary: In a neon city, a teenager with amber braids and a jade compass rallies dwarfs for an unknown voyage. They hurry, using a jackscrew on a chopped hovercraft, a clever gimmick against any capsize. Soon, a charming, pumpkin-orange truck carries a kachina doll, its coloring vivid. Suddenly, something occulted vanishes in a whiplash blur, horrifying the dreamer, envying anybody who could vanish like that. As vehicles are paged, a dragon's fiery breath causes unbelievable chaos, jamming a drill. The kingly brownie bucks are useless as the jade compass undergoes activation. Finally, a vast splash dissolves the world into a junky underworld. The protagonist walks away from the wreckage, leaving warzones and a changed reality locked into place.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: In a city of steel and circuits, a peculiar crew prepares for an unknown voyage.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant concept art, 16:9 widescreen landscape. Warm golden hour light bathes a sprawling, futuristic cityscape. Towering offices and computer data centers dominate the background. In the foreground, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is surrounded by playful, diminutive dwarfs. They hurry to undertake an upcoming, unknown task. One dwarf clunked a massive jackscrew into place beside a drained oarlock on a small, chopped hovercraft, its engine having threatened to capsize earlier. The scene feels enveloped in a sense of urgency, yet their unaltered backups are readily available, a clever gimmick for any tricky matchups. An eyewink from the teen signals they are ready.

scenes.sentence: A charming, yet strange truck, carries a secret ingredient, as a dreamer's vision turns to horror.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant concept art, 16:9 widescreen landscape. Cool, desaturated light paints a medium shot of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, standing beside a charming, but shlocky, pumpkin-orange truck. The truck's bed is filled with an odd ingredient: a massive, glowing kachina doll, its coloring strangely vivid. The teen is a dreamer, but a horrified look crosses their face. They just witnessed something occulted vanish in a whiplash blur, envying anybody who could undertake such a feat. A group of other teenagers watch from a distance, affably wondering whereby such a thing could happen. Narwals, almost heavenly, swim in an ethereal sky.

scenes.sentence: Amidst furious chaos, a mystical compass activates, its needle spinning wildly.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant concept art, 16:9 widescreen landscape. Harsh rim lighting casts deep shadows on an extreme close-up of the cracked jade compass on a leather cord, clutched in the hand of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids and oil-stained mechanic coveralls. The compass needle spins wildly, its activation undergoing a powerful surge. The background is a chaotic blur of vehicles and neolithic structures, all vividly lit by a terrifying dragon's fiery breath. Mohawks flash past as a retaliation drill is jammed into a control panel. The unbelievable power upchuck from the dragon creates a noir atmosphere. Even the kingly brownie bucks are useless except as art, tanned by the intense heat. The teen’s knuckles are white, paged for a confrontation.

scenes.sentence: The project’s aftermath leaves a world transformed, a new reality locked into place.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant concept art, 16:9 widescreen landscape. Soft, diffused light illuminates a wide overhead shot of a desolate landscape, full of the wreckage of warzones. A lanky, fluffy hound, a majestic peacock, and a group of ambiguous freaks are visible in the foreground. The earlier project has caused a catastrophic splash, dissolving the previous world into an underworld. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is seen in the distance, a small figure walking away from the frontline. The glare of an icicle-like structure reflects in a pool of water, locking the new reality into place. A silent flyby of a single junky vehicle hints at a changed world.
